In a bureaucratic reshuffle, the Tamil Nadu government has transferred C. Muthukumaran, District Collector, Karur, and posted him as District Collector, Tiruppur, replacing Manish S. Narnaware, who has been appointed Managing Director of Tamil Nadu FibreNet Corporation Limited.
S. Prasanna Ramasamy, Deputy Secretary to Governor (Universities), Lok Bhavan, Chennai, has been appointed District Collector, Karur, replacing C. Muthukumaran.
S.P. Karthikaa, Chief Executive Officer, Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority, has been transferred and posted as Additional Secretary, Social Welfare and Women Empowerment, replacing S. Valarmathi, who has been appointed Director, Rehabilitation and Welfare of Non-Resident Tamils.
R. Sadheesh, Director, Rehabilitation and Welfare of Non-Resident Tamils, has been transferred and posted as Director, Sericulture, Salem. Monica Rana, Commissioner, Tirunelveli Corporation, has been transferred and posted as District Collector, Tenkasi, replacing Ranjeet Singh.
M. Indhumathi, Chief Administrative Officer, Koyambedu Market Management Committee, Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority, has been transferred and posted as Deputy Secretary, Transport Department.
S. Sangeetha, District Revenue Officer, Amma Unavagam, Greater Chennai Corporation, has been appointed Director-cum-Mission Director, Integrated Child Development Services, Chennai, replacing K. Santhi, who has been appointed Managing Director, Overseas Manpower Corporation Limited.
N. Kalidoss, Zonal Officer-10, Greater Chennai Corporation, has been transferred and posted as Additional Director (General), Directorate of Rural Development and Panchayat Raj, Chennai. R. Venkateshwaran, Sub-Collector, Karur Division, has been transferred and posted as Sub-Collector, Chidambaram Division, Cuddalore district, replacing M. Subadharshini, who is on maternity leave.
R. Priya, Managing Director, Subramania Siva Cooperative Sugar Mills Limited, Dharmapuri, has been appointed Managing Director, Salem Starch and Sago Manufacturers’ Service Industrial Co-operative Society Limited (SAGOSERVE), replacing R. Keerthy Priyadharshini.
R. Rajakirubakaran, General Manager (Procurement), Electronics Corporation of Tamil Nadu Limited (ELCOT), has been appointed Executive Director, ELCOT. K. Priya, Joint Director (Technical), Directorate of e-Governance, has been appointed Commissioner, Tirunelveli Corporation, replacing Monica Rana.
M. Manimegalai, General Manager, Tamil Nadu Ex-Servicemen Corporation (TEXCO), has been appointed Vice-Chairman and Managing Director, Tamil Nadu Watershed Development Agency, replacing R. Kannan, who was holding additional charge.
A. Meena Priya Dharshini, Joint Director, Directorate of Children Welfare and Special Services, has been appointed Managing Director, Tamil Nadu Small Tea Growers’ Industrial Cooperative Tea Factories Federation Limited (INDCOSERVE), Coonoor, replacing Raja Gopal Sunkara.
T. Sengottaiyan, Special District Revenue Officer (Land Acquisition), Highways Department, has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, Chennai Metro Asset Management Limited (CMAML), replacing Sweta Suman. S. Shanthi, Joint Commissioner, Commissionerate of Prohibition and Excise, has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority, replacing S.P. Karthikaa.
Some of those who were transferred and posted had been recently inducted into Indian Administrative Service from Tamil Nadu State Civil Service.
